subject: OneTrust vendor portal: request to provision Redwood profile & evidence
messages:
From: Jenna Holt <jenna.holt@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: OneTrust profile request for Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan,

We're starting procurement for our new payments platform and need Redwood's vendor security profile in OneTrust completed before we can move to the next phase. I created a request in our portal and provisioned access for a vendor contact — the link is below.

Could you confirm who on your side will own the OneTrust form and whether you can attach your SOC 2 summary and network diagram? Our security team will follow up with any clarifying questions.

OneTrust request: https://onetrust.thirdpartyportal.com/portal/AcmePayments/request/REDWOOD-2026

Target timeline: we need completed profile + evidence by EOD 2026-05-04 to meet vendor review for our pilot.

Thanks,
Jenna Holt
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Acme Payments

Attachment: none (link to OneTrust request)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Holt <jenna.holt@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OneTrust profile request for Redwood Inference

Hi Jenna — thanks for the heads-up and the portal link. I've looped in Marissa (security/compliance lead) and Karthik (solutions engineer) to handle the OneTrust submission and the evidence upload.

Marissa / Karthik — could one of you take ownership? The ask is to complete the CAIQ/SIG-aligned OneTrust profile and attach:
- Redwood SOC 2 summary (latest)
- Network diagram (high level)
- Data flow mapping spreadsheet

We can complete this by close of business Monday (2026-05-04) but will flag any items that need redaction or an NDA before upload. Jenna — we'll confirm once the portal has the documents and let you know if any questions surface.

Jordan Blake
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OneTrust profile request for Redwood Inference

On Fri, May 1, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik — could one of you take ownership? The ask is to complete the CAIQ/SIG-aligned OneTrust profile and attach:
> - Redwood SOC 2 summary (latest)
> - Network diagram (high level)
> - Data flow mapping spreadsheet

I've started the profile in OneTrust and uploaded the SOC 2 summary and the network diagram to the request. Karthik — I left the data-flow spreadsheet for you to populate the app-specific section (what data elements are sent to Acme, retention windows, and KMS details).

Quick notes:
- SOC 2 summary attached: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (redacted answers included)
- Network diagram attached: network-diagram.png (public cloud VPC + peering callouts)
- Data-flow template attached: data-flow-mapping.xlsx (please fill tabs: Acme-requests, LoggingRetention)

Jenna — once Karthik completes the minor app-specific fields I will mark the portal submission as "Complete". If Acme's team needs our underlying SOC report (full PDF) we'll request an NDA & secure transfer.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, network-diagram.png, data-flow-mapping.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Holt <jenna.holt@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: OneTrust profile request for Redwood Inference

Thanks — I've updated the data-flow-mapping.xlsx in the OneTrust attachments and populated the following fields:
- Data elements shared: payment_token (pseudonymized), customer_email, transaction_amount, device_fingerprint
- Retention: transaction logs 90 days, analytics 365 days, tokens stored 30 days (rotated via KMS)
- KMS: AWS KMS CMKs (account scoped), keys rotated quarterly

Marissa marked the portal as complete and I confirmed all checks in the SIG/CAIQ section. Jenna, you should now have the SOC summary + network diagram + completed data flow spreadsheet in OneTrust. Please let us know if you need the full SOC 2 report (we'll require an NDA) or any additional evidence.

Jordan — flagging for BAU: we should note in our tracker to refresh the OneTrust answers quarterly or after any infra changes.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: data-flow-mapping.xlsx (updated)
